notes: OpenTick itself is released into the public domain under the Unlicense, so you may copy, change and share it freely.
The app is built with Tauri. Its web view is provided by your operating system (Microsoft Edge WebView2, WebKit, or Android System WebView) and is not bundled.
No fonts are bundled: text uses your system's fonts. Sound effects are generated in the app and use no audio files.
Rust crates beyond the direct dependencies are listed only when Cargo.lock is committed and `cargo` is available when this list is generated.
